comparison.objective: Place caplets into selected organizer compartments and snap all lids shut.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-object placement plus bracing and operating snap lids.
comparison.success_condition: Correct caplets in Monday/Thursday, other compartments empty, lids snapped, organizer stable and released.
comparison.reason: Tests discrete compartment loading and latching, not size/orientation-dependent bulk separation through a screen.
